build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Explore at least three connected city districts, move freely between rooftops and streets, and locate temporal anomaly scenes through a scanner. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Reconstruct each missing-second scene by rotating a time echo, matching evidence positions, and locking a plausible sequence before the timer expires. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Interview witnesses whose testimony changes with trust and discovered evidence, then connect clues on an interactive conspiracy board. Score 0 if the system is absent, decorative, or cannot be completed through player input. Score 1 requires the full interaction and its success/failure consequences to be observable in one playable flow.

Include multiple anomaly types, such as displaced vehicles, duplicated civilians, frozen projectiles, and corrupted security drones. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Track public trust and institutional suspicion; accusations, leaked evidence, and reckless scanning must change NPC reactions and available routes. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

End with a playable confrontation where the player selects and proves one of several theories, producing visibly different city outcomes. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

Solving district cases upgrades scan range and time-echo control, opens restricted locations, and unlocks increasingly complex reconstructions. Score 0 if this content is missing or differs only through labels or color swaps. Score 1 requires functionally distinct content that changes the player's decisions.

The HUD clearly communicates current objective, critical resources, selected target or mode, progress, and danger states in stable regions. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

Every important player action has immediate, distinguishable feedback for valid input, invalid input, success, damage or failure, and state change. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The full loop is connected: styled title and start flow, playable core systems, progression or escalation, final success/failure state, and retry or return navigation all work without reloading the page. Score 0 if essential information or feedback is missing, unreadable, overlapping, or disconnected from the game state at 1280x720.

The project has a coherent authored art direction: A rain-slick near-future metropolis with cyan forensic projections, amber street lighting, graphic-novel shadows, and sharp temporal fracture effects. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.

The 3D environment has deliberate composition, lighting, material contrast, depth cues, and themed landmarks rather than an empty floor with scattered objects. Score 0 if the presentation is dominated by default controls, unlit primitives, inconsistent materials, or abrupt unanimated state changes.
